messages:
Maria (MKTG): Hey team — need a quick run at visuals for the upcoming firebreak campaign (webinar + inbound kit). Goal: one hero diagram, 3x microtiles (latency/cost/quality), a flow diagram for inbound lead routing, and a single-page webinar slide with key benchmark sparkline. Deadline: EOD Wednesday (48h).

Joel - Design: Got it. Can you prioritize which asset to mock first? Hero or the funnel flow? Also need the final headline + 1-2 supporting bullets.

Maria (MKTG): Priorities: 1) Hero diagram (for landing + social), 2) Inbound routing flow (for ops handoff), 3) Microtiles for blog & slides. Headline: “Serving Wins: Make inference predictable and economical.” Bullets: “Latency SLOs across deployments”, “Cost controls with batching + quantization”. Keep copy tight — we’ll iterate.

Li (Creative Ops): Adding templates: I uploaded a rapid canvas and the microtile grid to Figma. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/rdw-firebreak-rapid-canvas — use the component set named rdw/microtile-v2. File contains tokenized colors and an accessibility contrast page.

Joel - Design: Thanks Li. Quick Qs: color vignette for hero — do we use full brand gradient or a muted background? Also, do we need animated sparkline for the webinar slide (gif) or static SVG?

Ruth - Brand: Use muted background for the hero (brand gradient only on accent elements). Accessibility: ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text. Avoid heavy drop shadows on microtiles. For the sparkline: static SVG is fine for the live slide; provide a GIF variant for social if time permits.

Samir PMM: For the microtiles, we want 3 variants: developer-facing (metrics + short CTA), enterprise (SLA + private deployment callout), and a neutral explainers one (how caching/batching works). Also include a tiny legend for quantization tradeoffs.

Joel - Design: Noted. Rough asset spec I'm going to follow:
```
hero: 1200x628 (png + svg)
microtile: 600x600 (png, svg)
webinar_slide: 1920x1080 (pptx export + png)
flow_diagram: 1200x900 (svg)
```
I'll keep components responsive.

Maria (MKTG): Also need file naming & delivery path so PM can ingest into Gong/demo packs. Naming convention: rdw_firebreak_<asset>_<variant>_v1. Ex: rdw_firebreak_hero_dev_v1.svg

Li (Creative Ops): Copying delivery checklist: include source Figma link, export PNG/SVG, export 72dpi PNG for web, 300dpi for print if requested, a short alt text, and localization sizes (square + vertical). I can run the exports if Joel wants handoff.

Joel - Design: I'll push an initial mock for the hero + flow into the Figma file tonight (2-3 hours). One ask: can marketing lock the headline copy now? Minor headline tweak might cascade through layouts.

Maria (MKTG): Headline locked for first mock. If we need a second variant for A/B, we’ll request a quick second pass. Samir — can you prepare 1 sentence for each microtile variant (sized to 60-80 chars)?

Samir PMM: Yep, will drop copy by 16:00 today.

Ruth - Brand: Small brand check — please don't use the old logo SVG with drop shadow. Use logos in /brand/logos/rdw_primary.svg (no effects). Also include the brand clearance approval checkbox in the handoff doc.

Maria (MKTG): Adding a soft constraint: localized versions for EU (FR/DE) will be needed later; please keep copy fields easy to swap.

Joel - Design: Understood. I'll create copy layers and mark with component tokens.

Figma Bot: Component "rdw/microtile-v2" updated by Joel - Design at 2026-03-24T20:15:22Z.

Li (Creative Ops): For inbound routing flow: suggest a simplified swimlane with three lanes (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) and routing rules. I'll sketch an ops-friendly PNG with numbered steps for runbook inclusion.

Maria (MKTG): Perfect. Can we get a deliverable checklist inline in the thread so ops knows what to expect? Short list please.

Joel - Design: Deliverables (v1):
- rdw_firebreak_hero_dev_v1.{svg,png}
- rdw_firebreak_flow_ops_v1.{svg,png}
- rdw_firebreak_microtiles_{dev,enterprise,explainer}_v1.{svg,png}
- rdw_firebreak_webinar_slide_v1.{pptx,png}
- handoff_readme_v1.md (links + alt text + brand checklist)

Li (Creative Ops): I'll scaffold the handoff_readme with export instructions and upload path (GDrive + Figma). Will also add accessibility notes and suggested alt text for each asset.

Ruth - Brand: Quick approval window: I'll review final Figma frames tomorrow morning. If anything uses component overrides outside tokens, flag it.

Maria (MKTG): Final — please ping #marketing-ops when hero + flow are in Figma for review. We're running a rehearsal on Thursday so we need the slide png no later than Wednesday EOD. :pray:

Joel - Design: Will ping when ready. Going to mock hero + flow now. :hammer_and_wrench:

Maria (MKTG): Thanks all — appreciate the hustle. :rocket:
